verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own Authentication SDK for out-of-band 3D Secure authentication of Adyen-issued cards. Its iOS SDK pages cover revealing card details and changing PINs. These are narrow, client-side SDKs for specific cardholder features, not general SDKs for the Issuing API. Missing for 10: evidence of official server-side SDKs covering the core Issuing API (cards, balance accounts, disputes), a list of supported languages, any Android or web SDK coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Authentication SDK integration also enables you to implement out-of-band authentication for Adyen-issued cards.
Allow your cardholders to see their card verification code (CVC), primary account number (PAN), and expiration date.
Allow your cardholders change their personal identification number (PIN) within your app.
